summary: The Dyson Camera Jet analyzes 28 images per second to detect gaps between teeth and automatically delivers bursts of mouth rinse while you brush.

title: Debt collectors are helping DHS fine immigrants while charging big fees

title: 20-year-old Haitian immigrant dies by suicide in Ohio; family blames deportation fears
